csv_agency: State of IN Department of Transportation
csv_scope_of_work: Project Development Services - Median construction for three corridor improvement projects on SR 53 from 61st Ave to US 20/12, Segments 4, 3 and 2. The selected firm will perform the design and plan development work necessary to produce the construction contract documents for 3 corridor improvement projects identified as Segments 4, 3, and 2 in the attached report. The selected firm will be required to provide all required Engineering Reports using attached Corridor Safety and Operations Evaluation, Environmental Documentation, all Permits, Public Involvement-including public hearing and public information meetings, Topographic Survey, Road Design, Utility Coordination, Hydraulic Analysis and Design, Right of Way Plan Development (including Abstracting, R/W Engineering and R/W Staking), Real Estate Acquisition Services including R/W Management, appraising, review appraising, and buying, pavement design, geotechnical design, traffic management plan, and Construction Phase Services. Due to the potential impact at ramp locations, this project will be required to follow the interstate access process. Additional services may also be required, such as, Wetland Mitigation, Archaeological Investigations, Historical/Architectural Investigations, and Subsurface Utility Engineering. INDOT will perform the Real Estate Closing activities. The selected consultant's fee proposal shall be due 45 calendar days after the selection date for this RFP item.
